question: Y036 proved eviction is genuinely exercised but LFU had no hot-motif benefit under quickly moving geometry. Does observed reentry frequency improve four-slot cache eviction when motif-cell neighborhoods remain stable and previous assignments are reusable, with collision pressure held?
hypothesis: Legal persistence is necessary for frequency-based eviction to matter; LFU may improve hot motif churn in a new fixed-home collision family. Conversely deterministic matching may already stabilize all assignments so LFU has no incremental benefit.
world: 16 circular cells and motifs, seven active per episode and four cached inactive slots over sixteen episodes. Use exact frozen Y035 SHA256 hot/cold active sequence on fresh seed96..103, but NEW constant-in-episode home map: for each motif key, fixed home=((7*(key//2)+SHA256salt(seed))%16), where adjacent motif pairs share a home and all neighbors are radius2. This differs from Y035/Y036's episode-drifting four-way homes. Full independent seven-key Hall max matching each episode and unique geometry-sequence SHA256 signatures.
arms: LRU four-slot cache, capped observed two-bit reentry-count metadata
LFU four-slot cache, identical metadata, evict lowest observed count, tie-break oldest then key
policy: Both arms use same matching algorithm, only legal observed cached preferences, max four inactive cached entries and <=7 active identity records, counts capped3 from observed reentries alone; no hot-key oracle labels or future episode access. Hot set for EVALUATOR only.
primary: Must have at least one eviction per heldout seed in both arms or classify CAUSAL_TEST_UNEXERCISED. Report hot-key returning-assignment churn, all returning-churn, legal cache hits, eviction counts, search calls, cache writes. FREQ_STABLE_GEOMETRY_BENEFIT if LFU hot churn strictly less aggregate, all churn not higher and LFU hot no worse in >=3/4 seeds; MIXED if LFU hot better but overall worse; NEGATIVE otherwise. INVALID for Hall/signature or memory-capacity violations; GEOMETRY_DEFICIENCY if underfull matches.
claim_limit: Synthetic hot/cold placement reuse under stable collided homes; no semantic or biological memory generalization.
